correctness.rationale: For r>=3, u=a+b>=4 and graph metric K_{a,b,1,...,1}, reconstructed the exact zero-sum quadratic form (2^p-1) sum_i s_i^2 - 2^p sum_x alpha_x^2 and the partwise Cauchy-Schwarz reduction to Rayleigh quotient min_{sum s=0} (sum s_i^2/n_i)/(sum s_i^2). Averaging singleton coordinates reduces the minimum to a two-dimensional generalized eigenvalue. Its determinant is rv*mu^2-((r-1)u+2v)*mu+(u+r-2)=0, v=ab; the smaller root is in (0,1). The exact negative-type boundary is -log2(1-mu), included at equality and violated above it by a partwise-constant witness. Since F(2/r,v)=(r-2)(1-u/r) and dmu/dv=mu(r*mu-2)/sqrt(discriminant), balancing decreases the exponent for u>r, increases it for u<r, and is flat for u=r. Recomputed exact rational exemplar roots and discriminant signs; numerical diagonalization is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
